body.text: DESCRIPTION:
Generate a SaXML file and store it in a container field
The context upon exit will be a SaXML layout with a record that has the xml file
This script is intended to be run via the Data API by a Bitbucket pipeline or a GitHub action; see https://bitbucket.org/soliantconsulting/saxml-delivery/src/main/
It can also be run directly by a full access user
PARAMETER:
JSONSetElement ( "" 	; [ "includeDetailsForAnalysisTools" ; True ; JSONBoolean ] // optional; defaults to true for supported versions of FileMaker, i.e. ≥21.1)
RESULT:
{ errorCode, message, data { recordId, xmlFieldName, timeToCreate, timeToUpload, addonVersion } }
CONTEXT:
Any
DEPENDENCIES:
The presence of the following solution elements in this database file:
"SaXMLDelivery" table
"SaXMLDeliveryExecutionContext" layout
NOTES:
There are a few places where custom functions would typically be used, but those were replaced with the bodies of those custom functions to maximize the portability of this script
HISTORY:
CLARIS-88 5/2/24 mkos: Created script based on bengert's POC script
2024-10-07 mkos: Added includeDetailsForAnalysisTools param
2025-08-29 mkos: Delete xml file in temp folder after it's uploaded to the container field
2025-08-30 mkos: Added addonVersion to script result
■■■■■■■■■■ Add-on version
CAUTION: This script runs with FULL ACCESS privileges
This is needed, because the Save as XML script step requires full access
https://help.claris.com/en/pro-help/content/save-a-copy-as-xml.html
Initialize vars
Send script to server via PSoS

body.condition: PatternCount ( Get ( ApplicationVersion ) ; "Server" ) = 0 // if not already running on fmse

body.text: Only try to do this if file is hosted
Validate privilege set - must be full access or must have access via the Data API
■■■■■■■■■■ CONFIGURATION STEP (optional): Customize restrictions to run this script

body.name: $allowedPrivilegeSet
body.value: Get ( AccountPrivilegeSetName ) = "[Full Access]" or not IsEmpty ( FilterValues ( Get ( AccountExtendedPrivileges ) ; "fmrest" ) )

body.text: Load optional param includeDetailsForAnalysisTools param into local variable

body.name: $_includeDetailsForAnalysisTools
body.value: Let ( [ 	includeDetailsForAnalysisTools = JSONGetElement ( Get ( ScriptParameter ) ; "includeDetailsForAnalysisTools" ) ; 	// isUndefined will be true if includeDetailsForAnalysisTools was not specified in the parameter (or the parameter is not valid json)	isUndefined = IsEmpty ( includeDetailsForAnalysisTools ) or Left ( includeDetailsForAnalysisTools ; 3 ) = "? *" ; 	split = Substitute ( RightWords ( Get ( ApplicationVersion ) ; 1 ) ; "." ; ¶ ) ; 	majorFileMakerVersion = GetAsNumber ( GetValue ( split ; 1 ) ) ; 	minorFileMakerVersion = GetAsNumber ( GetValue ( split ; 2 ) ) ; 	// "Include details for analysis tools" became available in FM 21.1	isSupported = $majorFileMakerVersion > 21 or ( $majorFileMakerVersion = 21 and $minorFileMakerVersion ≥ 1 )] ; 	Case ( 		isUndefined ; // if includeDetailsForAnalysisTools wasn't specified in the parameter		isSupported ; // default to true, but only if the fm version supports it		not isSupported ; // otherwise, if it's not a supported feature		False ; // default to false		includeDetailsForAnalysisTools // if it was specified in the parameter, and it's a supported feature, use the value from the parameter	))

body.text: Remember parent script's error capture state
PROCESS
Set up context
Purge old records
Delete records older than 3 months

body.name: $purgeDate
body.value: Let ( 	today = Get ( CurrentDate ) ; 	Date ( Month ( today ) - 3 ; Day ( today ) ; Year ( today ) ) )

body.condition: Get ( FoundCount ) > 0 and Get ( LayoutTableName ) = GetValue ( Substitute ( GetFieldName ( SaXMLDelivery::xmlFile ) ; "::" ; ¶ ) ; 1 ) // belt and suspenders

body.text: Create new record
Create SaXML xml file on file system
2024-10-07 mkos: Added support for $_includeDetailsForAnalysisTools
Upload xml file to container field
Note, we tried using the Read From Data File step, but it's not any faster, and it makes the code more complex, bc you have to read the file in chunks
2024-07-17 mkos: Don't automatically encode url since ConvertFromFileMakerPath will already do that for us
Delete xml file in temp folder
Handle error
